title: Restoring the Black Family: A Conversation with Delano Squires
gist: Brad Wilcox interviews Heritage Foundation's Delano Squires on his book The Vanishing Black Family, which blames 1960s welfare expansion (AFDC as 'substitute father') and second-wave/black feminism for the collapse of black marriage — 69% of black children now born outside marriage versus over 75% born to married parents in 1959 despite 55% poverty. Squires proposes bully-pulpit messaging, reporting data by family structure, success-sequence education, a $2,500-at-birth NEST marriage trust, and church-led marriage ministries.
